name: dsh-env-probe
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: probes the local machine environment (OS / shells / runtimes / tools / disks / proxy) once, caches the report, and injects it into every session's system prompt so the agent starts each conversation already knowing what this computer offers. Adds /env-refresh and /env-suggest slash commands where a command adapter is composed.
